$comment: What this deployment cost, in the unit it actually bills in: hours of EXISTENCE, not
images. Written by hand from observation, because there is no per-image cost signal on
the response — background, quality and usage all return null.
THE HOURS BELOW ARE SHARED. One deployment served all three asset repositories one after
another, so these hours are joint and cannot be attributed to this repository alone. There
is no non-arbitrary way to split them: by asset count, by wall clock, by pixels? Each gives
a different answer and none of them is a fact. compare.py therefore reports the figure and
refuses to divide it by this set's generation count.
`createdAt` is null and stays null. The deployment existed before this run began and ARM
does not expose a creation timestamp for a project-scoped managed-compute deployment, so
the true billed lifetime is LONGER than the window recorded here — provisioning and warming
are billed too, and the endpoint was returning `500 Model service is unavailable` for at
least 17 minutes of observed probing before it served. Recording an unknown as a number
would be the one thing COMPARISON.md section 6 exists to prevent.
hoursBasis: observed working window only, first to last successful generation across all three sets; excludes provisioning and warming, which are billed and are not on record

why: It could not be deleted from here, and the honest record is that rather than a deletedAt
timestamp that would make the bill look closed when it is not.
